title: The Dedication of the Temple

questions.question: What happened as soon as Solomon finished his prayer?
options: Fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering
questions.correctAnswer: Fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 7:1 (ESV): "As soon as Solomon finished his prayer, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering..."

questions.question: What filled the temple?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 7:1 (ESV): "...and the glory of the LORD filled the temple."

questions.question: What did the people do when they saw the fire and glory?
options: Bowed down with their faces to the ground on the pavement and worshiped
questions.correctAnswer: Bowed down with their faces to the ground on the pavement and worshiped
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 7:3 (ESV): "When all the people... saw... they bowed down with their faces to the ground on the pavement and worshiped..."

questions.question: How many oxen did the king and all the people sacrifice?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 7:5 (ESV): "King Solomon offered as a sacrifice 22,000 oxen..."

questions.question: Where did the priests stand?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 7:6 (ESV): "The priests stood at their posts..."

questions.question: Why did Solomon consecrate the middle of the court?
options: Because the bronze altar was not able to hold the burnt offering and the grain offering and the fat
questions.correctAnswer: Because the bronze altar was not able to hold the burnt offering and the grain offering and the fat
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 7:7 (ESV): "...for the bronze altar that Solomon had made was not able to hold the burnt offering..."

questions.question: How long did they keep the feast?
options: Fourteen days total (7 for altar + 7 feast)
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 7:8 (ESV): "At that time Solomon held the feast for seven days..."

questions.question: On what day did he send the people away to their homes?
options: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month
questions.correctAnswer: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 7:10 (ESV): "On the twenty-third day of the seventh month he sent the people away to their homes..."

questions.question: When did the LORD appear to Solomon again?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 7:12 (ESV): "Then the LORD appeared to Solomon in the night..."

questions.question: If God shuts up the heavens or commands the locust, what are His people to do?
options: Humble themselves, pray, seek His face, and turn from their wicked ways
questions.correctAnswer: Humble themselves, pray, seek His face, and turn from their wicked ways
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 7:14 (ESV): "if my people... humble themselves, and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways..."

questions.question: What did God say He would do if they met His conditions?
options: Hear from heaven and forgive their sin and heal their land
questions.correctAnswer: Hear from heaven and forgive their sin and heal their land
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 7:14 (ESV): "...then I will hear from heaven and will forgive their sin and heal their land."

questions.question: What did God promise regarding His eyes and heart for the temple?
options: My eyes and my heart will be there for all time
questions.correctAnswer: My eyes and my heart will be there for all time
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 7:16 (ESV): "...My eyes and my heart will be there for all time."

questions.question: What warning did God give if they turned aside to serve other gods?
options: I will pluck you up from the land... and this house I will cast out of my sight
questions.correctAnswer: I will pluck you up from the land... and this house I will cast out of my sight
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 7:20 (ESV): "then I will pluck you up from my land... and this house... I will cast out of my sight..."

questions.question: What would the temple become if they forsook God?
options: A proverb and a byword among all peoples
questions.correctAnswer: A proverb and a byword among all peoples
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 7:20 (ESV): "...and I will make it a proverb and a byword among all peoples."

key_verse_text: If my people who are called by my name humble themselves, and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven and will forgive their sin and heal their land.
